newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Aug real ind output rises 5.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Aug real ind output rises 5.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real definitive industrial output in August grew by 5.8 percent compared with the same month in 1995, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
It added that average industrial monthly wages grew, in nominal, 15.1 percent in August compared with a 19.7 percent in July, year-on-year.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT AUG/96 JULY/96 JAN-AUG 96 AUG/95

NOTE. Preliminary estimates in brackets. The average nominal industrial wage in August was 9,307 crowns compared with 9,633 in July. Wage results sample companies with 100 or more employees while output results include estimates of smaller firms as well.
